layout.compressors: 2 purchased 5-stage diaphragm compressor envelopes in the +X end bay (node compressor_design)
layout.nozzle_spread: connections land on the side rails; schedule heights that fit the rack are drawn as issued, the rest clamped (per-tag in check.nozzles_drawn); the N9 power terminal is a cable - carried verbatim, not drawn
layout.hardware_idiom: stubs lap the rails or skid so every union fuses; bbox = the A-M-167 rack envelope exactly
